coverage: 12 current cantons and 100 communes from the official ACT dataset updated 5 October 2026. Canton fills are dissolved from the same commune polygons so their edges agree at both levels. External display edges follow the existing France, Germany and Belgium outlines within a 300 m candidate corridor; original ACT geometry is retained unchanged among the sources. Historical districts in the download are intentionally excluded: districts were abolished in 2015. Identifiers preserve the source LAU codes; no population or economic values are inferred.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

displayAlignment.reference: Existing France, Germany and Belgium detailed display outlines
displayAlignment.policy: Only national-edge source differences are reconciled; administrative identities and the internal commune edges remain from ACT.
